1) Background / Context

Flarum is a simple yet powerful discussion platform designed to facilitate community engagement and interaction. It caters to a wide range of community sizes, from small groups to enterprise-level organizations. Built on a core framework, Flarum is highly extensible and offers extensive customization options through various extensions.

 2) Objectives

- Develop a discussion platform that supports community interaction.
- Provide extensibility and customization to meet diverse community needs.
- Ensure scalable performance regardless of community size.

 3) Stakeholders & Users

- Community Members: Users who participate in discussions.
- Administrators: Users who manage and customize the forum.
- Developers: Individuals or teams extending/customizing the platform.

 4) Functional Descriptions

- User Registration: Users can create accounts to participate in discussions.
- Permission Management: Configurable permission groups for access control and defining actions like moderation.
- Discussion and Post Management: Users can create, comment, and manage discussions and posts.
- Content Editing: Support for simple editors like bbcode/markdown and WYSIWYG for creating posts.
- Theme and Style Customization: Administrators can customize appearance via themes and custom CSS.
- Real-time Interaction: Notifications and updates through in-browser and email communication. Option for websocket integration for real-time updates.
- Extension Support: Facility to extend functionality through numerous available extensions or custom development.

 5) Non-Functional Descriptions

- Scalability: Capable of supporting communities of varying sizes efficiently.
- Extensibility: Hundreds of extensions available with options for further customization.
- Usability: Intuitive interface for both community members and administrators.
- Security: Secure handling of user data and transactions, with features like tokenized access and API key management.
- Performance: Optimized to ensure quick response times and fluid user experience even under heavy load.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0014

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `avatar_url` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `bio` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_email_confirmed` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `joined_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_seen_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `discussion_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `comment_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_suspended` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `suspended_until` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `preferences` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `groups` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name_singular` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `name_plural` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `color` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `icon` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_hidden` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_groups` (
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `group_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`, `group_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_groups_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `user_groups_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`group_id`) REFERENCES `groups` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `permissions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `group_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `permission` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `permissions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`group_id`) REFERENCES `groups` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `tags` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `color` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `icon` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `parent_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `position` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `discussion_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `last_posted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_restricted` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_hidden` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tags_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `tags` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `discussions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `comment_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `participant_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `view_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `first_post_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_post_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_posted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_posted_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_locked` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_sticky` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_private` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_approved` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `hidden_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `hidden_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `discussions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `discussions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`last_posted_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `discussions_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`hidden_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `discussion_tag` (
  `discussion_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `tag_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`discussion_id`, `tag_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `discussion_tag_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`discussion_id`) REFERENCES `discussions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `discussion_tag_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`tag_id`) REFERENCES `tags` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `posts` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `discussion_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `type` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'comment',
  `content` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `edited_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `edited_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `hidden_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `hidden_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ip_address` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_approved` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `number` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`discussion_id`) REFERENCES `discussions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`edited_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`hidden_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `post_likes` (
  `post_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`post_id`, `user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `post_likes_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`post_id`) REFERENCES `posts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `post_likes_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `discussion_user` (
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `discussion_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `last_read_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_read_post_number` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `subscription` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`, `discussion_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `discussion_user_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `discussion_user_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`discussion_id`) REFERENCES `discussions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `notifications` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `from_user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `type` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `subject_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `subject_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `data` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `read_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_deleted` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `notifications_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `notifications_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`from_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `access_tokens` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `token` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `last_activity_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `type` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'session',
  `title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ip_address` varchar(45) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_agent` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `access_tokens_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `api_keys` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `key` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `allowed_ips` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `scopes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `last_activity_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `api_keys_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `settings` (
  `key` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `value` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`key`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `extensions` (
  `id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `enabled` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `settings` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `installed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `version` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `email_tokens` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `token` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `email_tokens_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `password_tokens` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `token` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `password_tokens_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `custom_css` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `css` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `custom_css_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
